product_metadata.title: Sterlingcraft Silver Finish Serving Tray, 9 x 6 inches, 7 1/4 X 4 1/4 Serving Area
features: A STYLISH AND CLASSY CHOICE - Possessing all the elegance of silver with none of the frustrating upkeep, our oval metal serving tray makes the perfect centerpiece for your dinner table.
NO POLISHING NEEDED - The proprietary SterlingCraft finish not only gives our serving platter a distinguished look, it also eliminates the need for polishing or other time-consuming maintenance.
SUITABLE FOR ALL OCCASIONS - Impress guests during a dinner party, or make your Thanksgiving spread look even more special.
FANTASTIC GIFT IDEA - Put a smile on a friend or family member's face by gifting them this elegant decorative serving tray. It's an ideal present for housewarmings, weddings, and birthdays.
SERVING SIZE - Inner serving dimensions are 7 1/4 inches by 4 1/4 inches.
description: Entertain with flair with the Sterlingcraft Oval Serving Tray! Plated in that special Sterlingcraft finish that never needs polishing, so you can spend more time on preparing and presenting foods than on polishing and cleaning. This 9-3/8" x 6-3/8" oval tray is ideal for serving hors d'oeuvres, petit fours, or home-made candies.
